business_problem: Myntra needed to modernize its lakehouse because legacy architecture issues and slow pipelines limited its ability to serve personalized experiences at the scale of its fashion marketplace.
solution_summary: Myntra uses Databricks Data + AI Platform, Delta Lake, and Apache Spark to support real-time shopping recommendations and retail pipelines. Myntra needed to modernize its lakehouse because legacy architecture issues and slow pipelines limited its ability to serve personalized experiences at the scale of its fashion marketplace. In practice, the implementation stores or organizes core datasets in Delta Lake, and runs transformation or AI logic on Databricks Data + AI Platform. Customer, product, and interaction data are consolidated into Delta Lake; Databricks Data + AI Platform applies analytics or model logic. The case study reports Connecting people with brands that bring them joy 35%, Reduction in overall data infrastructure costs 25%, and 35%, showing measurable improvement after the rollout.
business_outcome: Myntra reported Connecting people with brands that bring them joy 35%, Reduction in overall data infrastructure costs 25%, and 35%, improving real-time shopping recommendations and retail pipelines with measurable gains in cost reduction, customer experience, and scalability.
